_voices: edge-tts offers only five fr-FR voices, one of which (Eloise) is a child voice -- so the roster is 2+2 adult metropolitan voices rather than the 4+4 the English site uses. fr-CA, fr-BE and fr-CH voices are deliberately excluded: this site teaches metropolitan French and a narrator should not drift dialect between one text and the next.
